training_data.name: EmpathLM Dataset V2
training_data.quote: No existing HuggingFace model is trained specifically for this task. This dataset was created to fill that gap.

description.text:
**Fine-tuned for Psychologically Safe & Persuasive Emotional Support**

EmpathLM is a fine-tuned version of [SmolLM2-135M-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct) trained to generate responses that combine **Motivational Interviewing (MI)** and **Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)** principles.

output_type.quote: EmpathLM is a fine-tuned version of SmolLM2-135M-Instruct trained to generate responses that combine Motivational Interviewing (MI) and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles.

use_claim.quote: Fine-tuned for Psychologically Safe & Persuasive Emotional Support

serving.text_only_input_quote: {"role": "user", "content": "I failed my exam again. I feel like I'm just not smart enough."}
serving.system_prompt: You are EmpathLM — an emotionally intelligent AI trained in Motivational Interviewing and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. When someone shares emotional pain: - Validate their feelings without judgment - Reflect their emotions back to them - Ask one powerful open-ended question - NEVER give unsolicited advice
serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. chat_template.jinja falls back to 'You are a helpful AI assistant named SmolLM, trained by Hugging Face' when the first message is not a system message. generation_config.json sets token ids only, not temperature. The usage example loads maliksaad/empathLM, not this repo. Training table says max sequence length 512. Safetensors count is 134515008 F32. training_args.bin is in the repo and was not decoded. https://github.com/maliksaad/empathLM returns 404.

evaluation_reported.text: EmpathLM was benchmarked against GPT-4o-mini and a Groq baseline on 20 unseen test situations, scored across: emotional_validation, advice_avoidance, perspective_shift, and overall_empathy. The card does not print the scores. It points at the GitHub repository, which returns 404.

discrepancies: The card names parent HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct and dataset maliksaad/empathLM-dataset, and it does not name an objective, which matches the empty methods cell. The same card's usage example and citation URL point at maliksaad/empathLM, not this repo. maliksaad/empathLM-dataset-v2 (760 rows) lists this repo under related resources and also says no Hugging Face model is trained for that task. The card's training table says ~180 examples (90% of 200), not 760.
